title: Resolute Sentinel joint exercise in Peru as a possible cover

tellings.quote: It was called Resolute Sentinel, and it involved it involved uh basically every military agency

plain: In 2023 a joint military exercise in Peru called Resolute Sentinel involved, in the words of the researcher Tim Alberino, "basically every military agency", and he suggests it may have served as cover for something else. Alberino brings it up with Michels without naming a source, and he does not spell out in this passage what it might have covered. If he is right, a routine exercise would have hidden some other military activity in Peru.
